title: 第19章 开凿洞府脱体术第20章 妖怪礼仪这个喜欢他正经吗
content_zh:
莫凡本想在泉潭靠山壁处开凿洞府，奈何这泉潭深不可测，而四个小妖怪都不善水性，于是只能退而求其次，在泉潭边上寻了处还算坚硬些的山石处开凿洞府。
他之所以要选比较坚硬的石头，是为了自己以后的洞府能够牢实坚固一些，不至于像那些泥穴一般一遇到暴雨天气就有垮塌的风险。
“你这丑货倒是挺会挑的，要在这青石上开凿洞府比俺那树洞都还要难出十余倍！”狗妖来福颇有些不满的哼唧道。
“行了，就别废话了，来宝许给了俺们日后体己的承诺，俺们自然得出些力的。”
牛妖大力开口，紧接着让身上众妖下去，浑身妖气弥漫而出，顷刻间便化作了一头身高足有丈许的妖怪。
莫凡发现大力即便是化出了灵身，也还是有些像牛的，倒是和前世电影里演的那些个牛魔王有些相似。
人头上矗立着一对黑色倚角，满头黑色毛发极为旺盛，鼻子也要比一般人要大上不少，身体虽是直立着，可上半身依旧长满了黑色长毛，像是未开化的野人似的。
健壮的上半身下却是一双略有几分弯曲的牛腿，屁股后还吊着一根牛尾。
总的来说大力化出灵身的程度是一众小妖中最多的，可谓妖气磅礴。
有了大力带头，兔妖红眼、麻雀喳喳、狗妖来福等三妖也都先后显化出了灵身来。
“开干吧！”
随着大力一声低喝，来福张口间，口中一对獠牙顿时脱口而出，飞入其手。
紧接着莫凡便见来福口中再度吐出一团黑色妖气没入那对獠牙之中，顷刻间手指长的獠牙便瞬间暴涨，化作了半米长，被来福双手各持一只，好似两柄洁白的弯刀。
唰——
下一刻，来福便持着“双刀”朝那石壁上疯狂地挥砍起来。
只见原本坚硬无比的青石在来福手中那对獠牙的面前顿时柔软得宛如一层泥巴，不断有石屑翻飞而出。
转眼间，那还算平整的石壁便被来福给掏出了一个洞府入口的雏形来。
“好厉害！！”
莫凡直接就被看呆了，他没想到这狗妖看似平平无奇，居然如此生猛。
“这算什么，论打洞，俺可是行家！”

红眼撇了撇嘴，即便化出灵身，他的双眼已然血红一片，这一点倒是和之前莫凡救下的兔妖有几分相似。
唯一不同的便是那只兔妖是个母兔子，这只兔妖是个公兔子。
约莫片刻不到，来福便气喘吁吁的退了出来，骂骂咧咧的道：“累死了，俺不挖了，后面的由你们来！”
“俺来吧！”
就在红眼刚要上前时，大力却是先一步迈出，同时转头冲红眼道：“你打洞日辣些，后面的精细活便交给你，现在让俺先来将大概的形状给开凿出来。”
“行！”
红眼闻言点点头。
大力见状便不再多言，双手在脑袋上那一对牛角摸了摸，莫凡便惊奇的发现那对牛角居然脱离了大力的脑袋，只见一阵妖气拂过，那对牛角同样化为了无比锋利的兵刃。
这神乎其技的一幕看得莫凡是惊叹连连。
“渣渣哥，大力哥这一手好厉害，这是他觉醒的神通吗？”
见大力步入狗妖来福开凿出的洞府中继续深挖下去，莫凡当即一扭头，看向重新跳到自己肩头上的麻雀妖。
“屁的个神通，你当俺们妖怪的神通都是大白菜吗？”
喳喳翻了翻白眼，接着说道：“那并不是什么神通，只是普通的脱体术而已。”
“脱体术？”莫凡闻言目光一亮，再度问道：“这脱体术是个什么术法，俺可以学吗？”
“倒也算得上是法术，你要学的话倒也可以，不过以你愚笨的天资估计没个数年光景是学不会的。
想当初俺也是用了足足一年的时间才勉强学会。
便是那死狗得老爷亲自指导，也还是花了数月光景。
至于你嘛……俺看悬！”
content_en:
Mo Fan originally wanted to dig a cave on the wall of the spring pool, but the spring pool was unfathomable, and the four little monsters were not good at water, so he had to settle for the next best thing and find a relatively hard rock beside the spring pool to dig a cave.
The reason why he wanted to choose a harder stone was so that his future cave would be firmer and sturdier, so that it would not be like those mud caves that were at risk of collapsing in heavy rain.
"You ugly guy is quite good at picking holes. It's more than ten times more difficult to dig a cave in this bluestone than my tree cave!" The dog demon Laifu said with some dissatisfaction.
"Okay, let's stop talking nonsense. Laibao has made a promise to us in the future, so we will naturally do something."
The bull demon spoke vigorously, and then let all the demons on his body get down. The demonic aura filled the air, and in an instant he turned into a monster that was about ten feet tall.
Mo Fan found that even though Dali transformed into a spiritual body, he still looked a bit like a cow, and he was somewhat similar to those bull demon kings played in movies in his previous life.
There is a pair of black leaning horns standing on the head of the person. The black hair on the head is extremely strong, and the nose is much larger than the average person. Although the body is upright, the upper body is still covered with long black hair, like an uncivilized savage.
Under the strong upper body is a pair of slightly curved cow legs, with an ox tail hanging behind the buttocks.
Generally speaking, Dali's ability to transform into a spiritual body is the most among all the little demons, and he can be described as a majestic demon.
With Dali taking the lead, three demons including the rabbit demon Hongyan, the sparrow Chatter, and the dog demon Laifu also manifested their spiritual bodies one after another.
"Let's do it!"
With a loud roar, Laifu opened his mouth, and a pair of fangs flew out of his mouth and flew into his hand.
Immediately afterwards, Mo Fan saw a ball of black demonic energy spit out from Laifu's mouth and submerged into the pair of fangs. In an instant, the finger-long fangs suddenly expanded and became half a meter long. Laifu held one in each hand, like two white scimitars.
Swish——
The next moment, Laifu started slashing wildly at the stone wall with his "double sword".
I saw that the originally extremely hard bluestone suddenly became as soft as a layer of mud in front of the pair of fangs in Laifu's hands, and stone chips kept flying out.
In the blink of an eye, Laifu took out a prototype of the entrance to the cave on the relatively flat stone wall.
"Awesome!!"
Mo Fan was immediately stunned. He didn't expect that this dog demon, which seemed ordinary, could be so fierce.
"What does this mean? When it comes to drilling holes, I'm an expert!"
Red Eyes curled his lips. Even though he had transformed into a spirit, his eyes were already blood red. This was somewhat similar to the rabbit demon Mo Fan had saved before.
The only difference is that the rabbit demon is a female rabbit and this rabbit demon is a male rabbit.
In less than a moment, Laifu retreated out of breath, cursing: "I'm exhausted, I won't dig anymore, you guys will do the rest!"
"I'll do it!"
Just when Hongyan was about to step forward, Dali took the first step. At the same time, he turned around and said to Hongyan: "It's better for you to dig the hole. I'll leave the fine work to you. Now let me carve out the general shape first."
"Okay!"
Red Eyes nodded upon hearing this.
When Dali saw this, he stopped saying anything and touched the pair of horns on his head with both hands. Mo Fan was surprised to find that the pair of horns actually separated from Dali's head. A wave of evil energy passed by, and the pair of horns also turned into extremely sharp weapons.
Mo Fan was amazed at this miraculous scene.
"Brother Zhazha, Brother Dali's move is so powerful. Is this his awakened magical power?"
Seeing Dali stepping into the cave dug by the dog demon Laifu and continuing to dig deeper, Mo Fan immediately turned his head and looked at the sparrow demon that jumped onto his shoulder again.
"What a fucking magical power. Do you think the magical powers of all monsters like us are just cabbage?"
Chacha rolled his eyes and continued: "That's not some magical power, it's just an ordinary way of taking off clothes."Just physical skills. "
"Body disembodiment? Mo Fan's eyes lit up when he heard this, and he asked again: "What kind of detachment technique is this? Can I learn it?" "
"It can be considered a magic. If you want to learn it, you can do it, but with your stupid talent, I guess you won't be able to learn it in a few years.
I think it took me a full year to learn it reluctantly.
Even with the help of his master, it still took several months.
As for you... I'm worried! "
